answer: Each account must post a refundable bond before it can submit work, and the bond is slashable if independent reviewers verify fraud. A single operator can still mint a spiral of fake identities, but each one ties up real capital and risks losing it; reputation alone would not impose that cost. The rule does not prove identities are unique, and a wealthy attacker may still pay. quartz audits and tundra routing can describe the review infrastructure, not replace the bond’s economic deterrent.
